visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a young woman with auburn hair tied in a bun, sitting comfortably on a soft grey sofa. She wears a grey fleece hoodie featuring a small white heart on the left side of the chest. In the background, several colorful plush toys, including a pink bear and a yellow Winnie-the-Pooh, are visible against a plain off-white wall. She looks directly at the camera with an animated expression, gesturing broadly with her hands as she introduces the video. (2) She unboxes a white Mary Jane high-heeled shoe that has a distinct fuzzy, shearling-like texture and a silver metallic buckle. She holds the shoe close to the lens to show the detail of the material and the thick block heel. She appears surprised at first, then happy, as she tries to figure out how to unbuckle the strap with her manicured hands. (3) The woman holds up a white long-sleeved t-shirt with a large, colorful graphic of the anime character Sailor Moon in the center. She holds it taut in front of her body so the full design is clearly visible to the viewer. The lighting is bright and even, likely from an indoor studio or living room lamp. (4) Transitioning to a festive mood, she dons a red headband adorned with two large, white fluffy pom-poms that resemble stylized heads. She smiles broadly and brings her hands together in a traditional Chinese New Year greeting gesture, swaying her body slightly to the rhythm. (5) She struggles to pull a red decorative scroll from a brown cardboard mailing tube. The scroll is long and made of red paper with gold Chinese characters. Her facial expressions convey effort and then relief as the item finally slides out of the tight container. (6) She poses wearing a highly stylized eyewear accessory—a frame without lenses, entirely covered in shimmering rhinestones or crystals that hang down like fringe. She moves her head side to side, allowing the light to catch the sparkles of the jewelry piece. (7) Finally, she unboxes a flat, rectangular board wrapped in protective plastic. Once unwrapped, it reveals a printed version of Van Gogh’s "The Starry Night." She demonstrates that it is not a traditional framed picture but a three-piece folding cat scratcher. She looks confused and then annoyed, holding up the white cardboard backing of the product to show its construction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice begins narrating at a fast tempo with clear articulation. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a steady 4/4 beat. The audio signal is clean with very low ambient floor noise. (2) A sharp "ding" sound effect triggers as the first item is presented. The narrator's pitch rises in excitement, and her speech rate remains high. The BGM continues with its bright synth textures and driving electronic percussion. (3) A digital "whoosh" transition sound effect marks the shift between segments. The narrator maintains an animated tone. There is a faint sound of fabric rustling as she handles a white t-shirt. (4) The audio texture shifts significantly as traditional Chinese percussion—specifically the clashing of cymbals and rhythmic drum beats—overlaps the electronic BGM. The narrator chants a festive greeting with a rhythmic cadence. (5) Audible sounds of paper sliding against cardboard and a hollow thud are heard as a scroll is pulled from a tube. The voice exhibits slight strain followed by relief. (6) A distinct "pop" SFX occurs, and the BGM switches to a bass-heavy hip-hop beat. The narrator's tone becomes more confident as she poses with rhinestoned eyewear. (7) Harsh sounds of plastic wrap being torn and the thumping of boards being dropped dominate. The narrator's voice changes to a lower, flatter tone. A sudden "huh?" vocalization is followed by a comedic "fail" record scratch SFX as the music stops.
